items.title: Devfest 2026: Building Safe, Secure & Scalable Solutions with AI and Cloud for Local Impact
items.text:
Date: 12 December 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 12 December 2026, 15:00 UTC
Location: Osun State University, Oke Bale Street, Osogbo
Registration: Free registration

Join GDG Osogbo for DevFest 2026 as we explore "Building Safe, Secure & Scalable Solutions with AI and Cloud for Local Impact." This year, we are moving beyond the hype to focus on practical, secure integration of artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure. Whether you are building low-bandwidth solutions for rural sectors or scaling cross-platform enterprise apps, join us for deep-dive technical sessions, hands-on labs, and ecosystem networking designed to empower builders to solve real-world challenges.
